names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 27 decembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Teodor Mărturisitorul», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 27 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Γραπτός», with the rank word left off and the by-name kept, as it is what distinguishes him.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s second heading for 27. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни мученик Теодор и Теофан Начертани.“ — «Преподобни» is the rank `venerable` and «мученик» the rank `martyr`, both of which §6 keeps out of a stored form, and «Начертани» is the EPITHET, standing in the plural at the end of the heading for both brothers: the body says «због чега су и прозвати Начертани», for which they were called the Written-on, so carrying it onto his own forename is the book’s own doing and not an assembly of mine. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN: the bare «Теодор» lands on five folders — `theodore-boyar-of-chernigov`, `theodore-of-perga`, `theodore-of-vrsac`, `theodore-prince-of-yaroslavl` and `theodore-the-sabbaite-of-edessa` — where the full string has no other holder at all. The brother’s folder has stored «Теофан Начертани» in the same shape since the 10-11 reading of this same book.

death.note: doxologia.ro gives no year for his death, only that he died in prison at Apamea and that afterwards «Murind împăratul Teofil, s-a dăruit Bisericii pace» and the icons were restored «în anul mântuirii 842». So his death is before that year and the page fixes no lower bound.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 27 decembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Teodor Mărturisitorul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Γραπτός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps on the Romanian calendar, and the entry is the same man: Theodore the Branded, brother of Theophanes, branded on the forehead by Theophilos and dead in exile at Apamea. The page's two cross-references both land on folders the corpus holds on exactly the Greek days it cites — his father «του Ιωνά (βλέπε 21 Σεπτεμβρίου)» and his brother «τον αδελφό του Θεοφάνη (βλέπε 11 Οκτωβρίου)» — which is what makes the two `related` rows. It gives no year for his death, only «Επί δε του Πατριάρχου Ιωάννου Ζ' (836 ή 837 μ.Χ.), εξορίστηκαν πάλι στην Απάμεια της Βιθυνίας, όπου ο Θεόδωρος πέθανε», so the folder's «before 842», which rests on the Romanian page, is left exactly as it stands. It adds that his relic was afterwards moved to Chalcedon and that a portion of it is now in the church of Saint Catherine at Thessaloniki; neither is drafted as a location. The second Theodore of this day, Θεόδωρος ο Α' Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κωνσταντινούπολης, is a separate entry and a separate man, drafted new in el-12-27. It prints an apolytikion, which names him and is taken. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 09.01.2026 (27. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни мученик Теодор и Теофан Начертани.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, whose heading names BOTH BROTHERS: „Преподобни мученик Теодор и Теофан Начертани.“ — and the other half of it is `theophanes-of-nicaea`, which already carried a venerated `serbian` row on 11 October and therefore took a §4 SECOND-DAY NOTE in this same commit rather than a row. This row is the plain one of the two, the folder’s `serbian` having been `undocumented`. Identified past any doubt: the epithet «Начертани», the brother named beside him, the house of Sabbas the Sanctified, the three iconoclast emperors, the verses cut into the face with iron, and the prison at Apamea of Bithynia where he died of his torments — every one of which the folder’s own life already carries out of doxologia and saint.gr. THE YEAR IS A REAL DISAGREEMENT AND WAS NOT WRITTEN. This book closes «Свети Теодор сконча 833. године», a flat 833. The folder holds `death` «before 842», an upper bound with a null `earliest`, because doxologia gives no year at all and only has the icons restored in 842 after Theophilus died. SO FAR THE 833 LOOKS LIKE A FREE IMPROVEMENT — AND IT IS NOT, BECAUSE THE THIRD BOOK CONTRADICTS IT: saint.gr, quoted in this folder’s own Greek note, puts the final exile to Apamea under the patriarch John VII, «836 ή 837 μ.Χ.», and has Theodore die THERE, which is after 833 and not before it. Two books cannot both be right and neither strikes out the other, so `dates` is UNTOUCHED, the 833 is recorded here and in the life beside the Greek reading, and IT IS THIS DAY’S AUTHOR QUESTION. `types` untouched: «Преподобни» is `venerable` and «мученик» is `martyr`; the folder carries `venerable`, `confessor` and `hieromonk`, and `martyr` is NOT added — a `types` row is a reading of the sources together and not of the newest one, the 11-05 reader’s `stephen-of-decani` precedent, and the Romanian and Greek that made this folder both rank him a confessor who died in exile rather than a martyr. Reported. No `locations`: Apamea is where he died and the folder has never had a coordinate. `related` UNTOUCHED — the row to `theophanes-of-nicaea` stands in both directions and the brother is the only saint the entry names; `jonah-the-sabaite`, his father, is not named in this entry at all and that row stands from the Greek reading. The Serbian form is the heading’s epithet carried onto his own forename, «Теодор Начертани»: the bare «Теодор» was measured first and lands on five folders, and «Начертани» is a plural epithet in the heading that the body gives to both brothers in so many words, which is why the brother’s folder has stored «Теофан Начертани» since the 10-11 reading. The full string has no other holder. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptătorule al Ortodoxiei, învăţătorule al dreptei cinstiri de Dumnezeu şi al curăţiei şi luminătorule al lumii, podoaba călugărilor cea de Dumnezeu insuflată Sfinte Părinte Teodor, înţelepte, cu învăţăturile tale pe toţi i-ai luminat. Alăută duhovnicească, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Teodor Mărturisitorul, glasul 8 (the common of a venerable teacher, printed with his name in it)

english.text: Guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of the right worship of God and of purity, light of the world, God-inspired adornment of monks: wise father Saint Theodore, by your teachings you have enlightened all. Spiritual harp, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Θείοις στίγμασι, σεσημασμένος, δῶρον ἔμψυχον, τῷ Ζωοδότῃ, προσηνέχθης θεοφόρε Θεόδωρε· Ἀσκητικαὶς δωρεαὶς γὰρ κοσμούμενος, ὁμολογίας Ἀγώσι διέλαμψας. Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the only hymn on the page of «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Γραπτός», and it names him.

english.text: Marked with divine brandings, you were offered as a living gift to the Giver of life, God-bearing Theodore; for adorned with the gifts of the ascetic life, you shone out in the contests of confession. Venerable father, entreat Christ God to grant us his great mercy.
